text: Attempt 11: attempt 10's audited layout built up front (blocks 1+2 on day one), pace check enforces the target curve, debt capped at 1 + population/8,000 loans, taxes 4/4/4, seaport at ~5,000, zoo ~10,000.
Loan #1 ($10,000). A second loan was refused: the game says the credit rating must improve first. Taxes 4/4/4.
Day one ($15,764): road + rail links, coal plant, fire stations x2, 288 light home tiles, shops, factories, 12 riverbank pumps, pipes. Build check and audit passed.

Attempt 10 missed (14,190 in 2018). The reflection over all ten attempts says land early is the strongest lever, so attempt 11 starts with 288 home tiles instead of 108. Learned today: the game refuses a second loan at founding (credit rating), so day one is capped at about $20,000.
Factory tax 4 -> 3 (jobs first: home demand at max, 261 empty home tiles, factories lead a small city).

Pace alarm, Feb 2001: 480 people vs 2,200 target. Land is not the problem (261 empty home tiles); the first year is slow because jobs come first. Cut factory tax to 3 and run on; next block when the credit rating allows a second loan.
Loan #2 ($10,000): the credit rating now allows it (refused in 2000).
2003 plan ($8,649): attempt 10's block 3 (east homes, shops, factory strip) and block 4 (south district, 264 home tiles). Home tiles zoned: 683 (pace target 672).

Audit stopped the clock: block 4's power column had a one-tile gap at (77,56) (attempt 10 fed it from the west plant, left out here) and the y38 water main was not joined. Fixed. Build check also caught one home tile at (87,40) that lost its zone during the fix and restored it.

Feb 2003: 2,970 people, behind the population pace (7,200) but land is now ahead: 683 home tiles zoned. Growth has been ~1,500 a year with land to spare, so the speed of building is the limit now, not land.

Power + water shortage (spare 4%/0%, 30 buildings unpowered): gas plant ($2,000; cash was $3,754, coal costs $4,000) on the river strip, joined via a new line column x75 and the crossing at (76,47); 5 riverbank pumps. Total $2,630.
Shop and factory tax 4 -> 6 (both demands at maximum; homes stay 4 - rule: homes last).
